verdict.rationale: Buzz documents its own workflow system: "YAML-as-code automation" in VISION.md, a `buzz workflows trigger`/`approve` CLI, and agents that "run workflows." The buzz-acp harness also automatically prompts an agent when an @mention event arrives on the relay. However, no evidence shows user-authored rules binding arbitrary events to actions; the workflow CLI shows manual triggering, and the YAML automation appears only as a one-line vision claim. Missing for 10: documented event-trigger rule syntax (which events, conditions, actions), evidence that workflows fire automatically on relay or repo events rather than by manual trigger, depth beyond the @mention harness, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: The harness listens for @mentions on the relay, prompts your agent, and the agent replies using the Buzz CLI.
